what_happened: An operator ran `athena plan --budget 15` as documented. The planning pass read all 25 queued requests. Reading a request moves it from queued to proposed, but `athena plan` and `drain` only look at queued requests. So after the run, 0 requests were queued, `athena plan` reported nothing open, and `drain` had nothing to work on. At the default `--budget 2` the pass read nothing and reported no room in the job limit or the budget.
cause: The queue states (queued, proposed) and the commands that consume them were defined separately. The planning pass added in #115 changed an item's state without any shared definition of which states plan and drain read. No end-to-end test ran plan then drain on a real queue, and the command had no dry-run or preview mode, so the mismatch only surfaced when an operator ran it on 25 live requests. The budget logic also has no explicit message or guard when the default leaves no room.
prevention: Define one state-transition table for requests that says which command reads and which command produces each state. Add an integration test that seeds queued requests, runs plan then drain, and asserts that every request read by plan can be reached by drain, or that plan and drain both include proposed requests. Make plan keep the request in a state drain consumes, or have drain take proposed requests. Make plan print what it would read and fail loudly when the budget leaves no room. Restore the 25 requests to queued.
proposed_request: Fix the athena planning pass so that running `athena plan` never strands requests. After `athena plan --budget N` reads requests, every request it read must still be visible to `athena plan` and `athena drain` as work to do (either keep them queued until a job starts, or make plan and drain both consume the proposed state). Add an automated test that seeds several queued requests, runs plan then drain, and checks that drain picks up the planned requests. Add a `--dry-run` option to plan that lists what it would read without changing any state. When the default budget or job limit leaves no room, plan should print which limit blocked it. Also restore the 25 requests that the last run moved from queued to proposed so they are queued again.
